digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 37
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore
items.summary: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore for managed clusters. Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running.
items.whyItMatters: Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running.

items.title: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets
items.summary: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets that several projects can read. Datasets are versioned, and a run records which version it used.
items.whyItMatters: A run records which version of a dataset it used.

items.title: Fenwick Backup adds incremental snapshots
items.summary: Fenwick Backup adds incremental snapshots that store only changed blocks. Restore history is listed in the console with the time range of each backup.

sources.title: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore
sources.summary: Kestrelbay DB adds point-in-time restore for managed clusters. Restores create a new cluster, so the original keeps running. Restore history is listed in the console with the time range of each backup.

sources.title: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets
sources.summary: Quillon Evals adds shared datasets that several projects can read. Datasets are versioned, and a run records which version it used. Access is controlled per dataset.

sources.title: Fenwick Backup adds incremental snapshots
sources.summary: Fenwick Backup adds incremental snapshots that store only changed blocks. Snapshots can be restored to a different region. Retention rules are set per volume.
